usage.callShape: GET https://api.x402node.dev/text/extract?text=<url-encoded free-form text> (x402 payment, ~$0.0022 USDC on base)

inputExample.text: Email me at john@example.com or visit https://x402node.dev #ai @bob ETH 0x4466d4A84b7c49a6A094ec6eef4a0712D6dd125e

usage.outputShape: body.emails[], body.urls[], body.phones_us[], body.hashtags[], body.mentions[], body.ipv4[], body.eth_addresses[], body.btc_addresses[], body.text_length, body.processing_ms
quirks: Input is a query parameter named 'text' (URL-encoded) on the GET request — NOT documented in the registry inputSchema (which only says type=http/method=GET/discoverable=true). You must know to append ?text=...
Categorized arrays come back directly in the top-level JSON body (no wrapper/job). Empty categories return [].
mentions[] also picks up the local-part of emails as a mention (e.g. john@example.com yields '@example' alongside real '@bob'). Deduplicate/cross-check against emails[] if precision matters.
Price advertised as 'Varies' but observed flat 2200 atomic units = $0.0022 USDC on base, asset USDC 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913.
usage.guide: Call GET https://api.x402node.dev/text/extract with the source text URL-encoded into a 'text' query parameter (e.g. ?text=Contact%20me%20at%20john@example.com). Pay the x402 quote (~$0.0022 USDC on base) — the endpoint gates payment before validating, so a 402 pre-flight is normal. Read the categorized entity arrays straight from the top-level JSON response body: emails, urls, phones_us, hashtags, mentions, ipv4, eth_addresses, btc_addresses. It is deterministic regex extraction, synchronous, no polling or auth beyond the wallet payment. Note that mentions may include email local-parts, so cross-reference emails[] when accuracy matters.
